sections.title: Two objects: to whom, and what
sections.content: ajánl ("to recommend") takes two objects: the person you're recommending TO, in the -nak/-nek dative you already met with keres, and the thing recommended, in the accusative -t. Ajánlok neked egy kiállítást means "I recommend an exhibition to you".

items.english: I recommend a good exhibition to you.
What do you recommend for this weekend?

sections.content: The person usually comes right after the verb: ajánlok NEKED egy kiállítást. Putting the thing first (egy kiállítást ajánlok neked) is grammatical too, but the first order is the natural, everyday one for a simple recommendation.
